name: Vael Ascendancy
blurb: A biomechanical polity that regards worlds as fruit. The Vael descend on a planet, render its crust into industry and move on before the husk cools. Their senate is a chorus of appetites held in uneasy balance.

affinity.name: Consumers
affinity.description: Colonised planets slowly deplete, losing one max population every 15 turns, but every world the Vael hold produces far more industry and food while it lasts.

name: Keth Exodus
blurb: The Keth lost their homeworld to a dying star and never trusted ground again. They live aboard arks the size of moons, settling a world only long enough to harvest what they need before uprooting the whole population and moving on.

affinity.name: Wanderers
affinity.description: Cannot build outpost ships. Instead the Keth build Arks that carry population and found full colonies instantly, and any Keth system can Uproot, loading its people back into an Ark.

traits.name: Ark-Born
traits.description: Arks found colonies instantly; systems can be uprooted.

name: Solenne Concord
blurb: An oceanic civilisation of slow, deliberate minds who settled their wars by treaty a thousand years before they reached orbit. The Concord cannot declare war, and finds the idea faintly absurd. It wins by being impossible to dislike.

affinity.name: Serene
affinity.description: Cannot declare war. Generates far more influence and approval, at the cost of weaker industry.

traits.name: Pacifist
traits.description: Cannot declare war; may always offer peace.

name: Mercator Syndicate
blurb: Less a nation than a cartel with a flag. The Syndicate sells everything, including loyalty, and prices every treaty in Dust. Its fleets are freighters first and warships second, which has never stopped them winning.

affinity.name: Brokers
affinity.description: Every unit of food, industry, science and influence produced also yields a fraction of Dust. Dust output is increased further, but research suffers.

traits.name: Everything Is For Sale
traits.description: +0.15 Dust per unit of any other resource produced.

name: Ferron Covenant
blurb: Dwellers of a dry, iron-rich world who worship the forge as the first cause. Every Ferron citizen is a shareholder in a foundry; every foundry is a temple. Their ships are ugly, over-armoured and extremely numerous.

affinity.name: Forgeborn
affinity.description: Ships cost far less and industry is greatly increased, but food is scarce and the populace is hard to please.

name: Oneiri Chorus
blurb: A linked consciousness that dreams in equations. The Chorus reproduces slowly and argues with itself constantly, but nothing in the galaxy learns faster. Other empires find its diplomats unsettlingly well informed.

affinity.name: Dreamers
affinity.description: Research is greatly accelerated and every citizen contributes science, but population grows slowly.

name: Corsair Compact
blurb: Deserters, debtors and the merely unlucky, bound by a charter nobody has read. The Compact raids whoever is nearest and sells to whoever is next.

affinity.name: Outlaws
affinity.description: At war with everyone, forever. Raids undefended colonies for Dust.

traits.name: Marked
traits.description: Bounties are paid for every Corsair hull destroyed.

name: Tidewrights
blurb: Reef-dwelling shipwrights who grow their hulls from coral.

affinity.name: Minor faction
affinity.description: A single-system polity. Win its goodwill with envoys and gifts to assimilate it, or take it by force.

name: Ashen Choir
blurb: Monastics who forge in the mouths of volcanoes and sing while they do it.

affinity.name: Minor faction
affinity.description: A single-system polity. Win its goodwill with envoys and gifts to assimilate it, or take it by force.

name: Glasswardens
blurb: Archivists sealed under ice, trading knowledge for warmth.

affinity.name: Minor faction
affinity.description: A single-system polity. Win its goodwill with envoys and gifts to assimilate it, or take it by force.

name: Dunefolk Compact
blurb: Caravan clans whose salt roads predate the star lanes.

affinity.name: Minor faction

name: Verdant Kin
blurb: A forest polity that mistakes visitors for weather.

affinity.name: Minor faction

name: Hollow Court
blurb: Exiled nobility ruling a cratered rock with ferocious etiquette.
